name: TF1 SA
summary: TF1 SA operates as a media and entertainment company, primarily engages in television broadcasting, content creation, and distribution of audiovisual rights in France, Continental Europe, and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Media and Studio TF1. The Media segment includes TV channels and content creation activities, the TF1+ free streaming platform, and produces and acquires audiovisual rights for TV channels in line with French broadcasting industry regulations. This segment engages in the sale of advertising space through individually negotiated space-buying deals and programmatic ad sale auctions; and making content and services.
